_comment: macOS native messaging host manifest for the MCP broker.
SETUP: Replace PLACEHOLDER_ABSOLUTE_PATH_TO_native_host.py with the absolute path to
src/mcp_gateway/host/native_host.py (or a compiled wrapper) on this machine.
Replace PLACEHOLDER_EXTENSION_ID with the Extension ID shown in chrome://extensions.
NOTE (Darwin): The 'path' executable must be owned by the current user and chmod +x.
macOS Gatekeeper may require: xattr -d com.apple.quarantine <path>
name: com.mcp.gemini.broker
description: Google Gemini Notebook MCP Native Messaging Host
